title: MCP Tool Discovery Workbench
tagline: A scoped MCP inventory server that discovers schemas inside a measured context budget.
summary: A scoped MCP inventory server that discovers schemas inside a measured context budget. Run python3 cli.py /absolute/inventory.json --serve as a stdio server. tools/call catalog_search takes query, max_chars and k; the response returns selected public schemas and their character count.
youWillBuild: A scoped MCP inventory server that discovers schemas inside a measured context budget.
usefulFor: Run python3 cli.py /absolute/inventory.json --serve as a stdio server. tools/call catalog_search takes query, max_chars and k; the response returns selected public schemas and their character count.
skills: Build a catalog of 250 read-only tools
Select tools under an explicit context budget
Audit catalog coverage through protocol pages
prerequisites: Python 3.10+, Node 22.18+, dictionaries, JSON-RPC request ids, stdin/stdout and child processes.

languageWhy.Python: Stdlib data structures, explicit algorithms and deterministic local tests.
languageWhy.TypeScript: Typed wire messages and real subprocess integration.

stages.title: Build a catalog of 250 read-only tools
stages.summary: The generated catalog contains exactly 250 unique tools.

stages.title: Audit catalog coverage through protocol pages
